The Trailhead Skillet

Our flagship ten-inch skillet is called the Trailhead, and it costs $89. Each one ships within three business days of your order, pre-seasoned and ready to cook with straight out of the box. It is oven-safe to five hundred degrees Fahrenheit and works on every stovetop, including induction.

Warranty

Every skillet we sell is covered for two years from the date of purchase against manufacturing defects such as cracks or uneven casting. If anything goes wrong with your skillet in that window, we will replace it at no cost to you.
